crossReferences.tweetClaim: Scaling alone solves intelligence — just keep adding parameters.
crossReferences.articlePassage: Diminishing returns past 70B parameters suggest that scaling alone is not sufficient.

crossReferences.tweetClaim: Self-attention is the key innovation behind modern LLMs.
